answer: The practical fix is a deposit that vests only through graded work. Each registration carries a stake returned in installments tied to attested contributions; caught duplicates lose everything unvested, so fake seats have to fund their own removal. In effect the tide of free entry disappears, the wharf of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the zenith case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Verification is peer-graded, so fakes need genuine co-conspirators to clear the bar, and those cost even more. One real contributor then costs less than one fake, and the swarm.
